description: This source file is a Python script for encoding firmware images, specifically for MOXA IW devices. It reads a firmware file, segments it into specific partitions, adds headers, computes CRCs, and encrypts the data using XOR encryption before writing the output.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: A data class representing a firmware partition with a name and size.

methods.name: bytes xor(data: bytes)
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption on input bytes with a predefined passphrase.

methods.name: bytes add_fw_header(data: bytes, magic: int, hwid: int, build_id: int, offsets: List[int])
methods.description: Adds a firmware header with metadata and CRC to the data.

methods.name: bytes add_file_header(data: bytes, filename: str, build_id: int)
methods.description: Adds a file-specific header with filename, size, and CRC.

methods.name: int crc(data: bytes, init_val: int)
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with an initial value and performs XOR mask.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates firmware processing, header addition, encryption, and file output.
